title: Civil Society Strengthening Programme for Children Rights
summary: Project kick-off with Sida (Sweden), running from 2026 to 2029 to strengthen child-centered community systems for children, youth, women, and families.
body:
Funder: Sida (Sweden / Sverige)

Duration: 2026 to 2029

Objective

Strengthen child-centered community systems.

Served

Children, youth, women, families.

Outcome

Dignity, access, protection, resilience.

title: Evidence and Policy Advocacy
summary: Turning research, field learning, and child-rights data into policy asks that decision makers can act on.

title: Child Protection Systems
summary: Supporting stronger prevention, reporting, referral, and response pathways for children at risk of violence or neglect.

title: Child Participation
summary: Creating safe spaces where children and young people can contribute to decisions that affect their lives.

title: Network Coordination
summary: Bringing civil society members, technical partners, and community actors together around shared advocacy priorities.
